originality.rationale: Related impossibility results share the adversarial obstruction but have different quantifiers: they exclude uniform positive factors as m increases, while the new result gives both a matching all-horizon constructive policy and the exact \(1/(m-3)\) minimax factor at sufficient height. The accessible five-good special case cannot entail the quantified \(m\ge6\) statement. Primary full theorem/appendix texts and mathematical-record queries were inspected; unindexed equivalents remain possible.
residual_risks: Unindexed conference appendices or other results may already state a related exact horizon-wise factor.
The height condition is sufficient, not necessarily optimal; the moderate-height minimax frontier remains uncharacterized.
No independent audit or public priority confirmation has been performed.

value.rationale: Turns a widely cited asymptotic impossibility into an exact and attained fixed-horizon online approximation law over every horizon \(m\ge6\). Horizon-wise guarantees and an implementable deterministic rule are naturally useful for bounded campaigns; the result is an infinite family with an analytical matching bound, not a small numerical special case.
